access.zh: API 与 ChatGPT 订阅；权重不开源。
access.en: API and ChatGPT subscription; weights are not open.

generations.zh: 当前旗舰：官方模型页 1,050,000 上下文 / 128,000 最大输出 / 知识截点 2026-04-30；发布走 Trusted Access 分批开放（央视新闻 2026-10 报道同口径）。
generations.en: Current flagship: official model page lists 1,050,000 context / 128,000 max output / knowledge cutoff Apr 30, 2026; launched through the Trusted Access Program in phases (same account in CCTV's October 2026 report).

generations.zh: 上一代线：GPT-5.2（400K 上下文）与 GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna（1.05M 上下文）在官方文档在册。
generations.en: Previous line: GPT-5.2 (400K context) and GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna (1.05M context) listed in official docs.

v.zh: 文本 + 图像输入、文本输出（官方模型页 Modalities 行）
v.en: Text + image input, text output (Modalities row on the official page)

positioning.zh: 闭源旗舰线：能力声明以官方发布页为准，本站只抄规格不背书横评。注意 OpenAI 另有一条开放权重线（gpt-oss），与这条 API 线是两回事——本站两边都有卡。
positioning.en: The closed flagship line: capability claims follow the official release pages; this site copies specs without endorsing comparisons. Note OpenAI also runs an open-weight line (gpt-oss) — a different thing from this API line; this site cards both.

onSite.zh: 本站开放权重侧收录的是 gpt-oss 系列（谱系卡与量化对比都在）；GPT-6 系不开权重，无量化话题。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers the gpt-oss line (family card + quantisation comparison); the GPT-6 line ships no weights, so quantisation does not apply.
